🇸🇩 #SUDAN: The paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF) struck the Blue Nile capital of Ed Damazin with drones. The strikes came as the RSF and allied fighters seized the town of Sali to the south.
Local media reported explosions overnight on November 3rd and 4th. Yale researchers found signs of an impact at a market in Ed Damazin’s Al-Zuhur neighbourhood. Satellite images also showed damage at a Sudanese army artillery compound.
Yale corroborated the capture of Sali by the RSF and the Sudan People’s Liberation Movement–North. Images showed widespread damage at an army camp near the town. Sali sits on the road from Ed Damazin to the Ethiopian border.
Yale counted more than 800 new temporary shelters at a displacement camp in Ed Damazin in the month to November 4th.

events.text: Russian forces are suffering heavier losses because autumn conditions favor Ukrainian drones, according to Joint Forces spokesperson Viktor Trehubov. Trees have shed their leaves, reducing concealment, while clear weather and manageable temperatures allow reconnaissance and strike drones to operate at full capacity. 🇮🇱 Israel builds up its ground forces for possible two-front war with Iran and Lebanon
Israel is broadening its infantry brigades with new specialized combat units, and its air force has rehearsed a rapid response to a large-scale ground infiltration from Lebanon, Maariv reported.
🔴 Combat engineering battalions have begun operating under several frontline brigades. These units will focus on drones, robotics, surveillance systems, advanced weapons, and precision-guided munitions
🔴 In addition, Israeli fighter jets carried out an unusually extensive low-altitude exercise over Nahariya and the western Galilee. Squadrons on immediate alert were activated and pilots were asked to assess whether a ground incursion was underway from the north, according to the source
The preparations come amid rising tension over a possible renewal of US military action against Iran. Reports in recent weeks have suggested that President Donald Trump may launch a new full-scale war on Iran now that the US midterm elections have passed, reducing the political cost.
Israeli security officials expect that in the event of war with Iran, the military would immediately mobilize all reserve divisions and move most forces north, with the stated aim of completely destroying the Hezbollah movement.

events.text:
⚛️📊 Palantir veterans raise $300mn to weaponize Europe’s arms supply chain
Two former [Palantir](https://t.me/geopolitics_prime/74041) employees have positioned themselves to profit from Europe's aggressive military build-up, reports the Financial Times.
The co-founders of Dutch start-up Onodrim, which recently raised $300mn at its $1.3 billion valuation, include Aistis Simaitis – one of Palantir’s earliest European hires, and Alexander Blessing, who helped build and deploy the firm’s [flagship Foundry platform](https://t.me/geopolitics_prime/70382).
The new vehicle plans to use its funding to:
🌏 acquire controlling stakes in smaller, often family-owned manufacturers with strategically important technologies
🌏 inject capital, software and management expertise to increase production capacity
🌏 address critical supply-chain bottlenecks, including drone propulsion, radar and sensing systems, explosives materials and aerospace structures
While the latest financing round was led by Lux Capital, an earlier initial $45mn seed round included Founders Fund, established by Palantir co-founder [Peter Thiel](https://t.me/geopolitics_prime/73660).
